text:
samir: Anyone else seeing the Android SDK hang only in release builds? Debug APKs are fine but release requests just never complete (no timeout/error). Repro in our sample app.

maria: Hmm, do you have an explicit callTimeout set on the OkHttpClient? Default is 0 (infinite).

samir: We set read/write timeouts in the Java wrapper but I realized the Kotlin wrapper that most apps use doesn't set callTimeout at all. Weird parity between libs.

kevin: Can you paste minimal repro steps?

samir: Steps: 1) clone repo; 2) build release (./gradlew assembleRelease); 3) install; 4) trigger sample chat. Happens consistently. Snippet from our app:
```kotlin
// in KtxClient.kt
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .readTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .writeTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  // missing .callTimeout(...)
  .build()
```

samir: In debug the same code works. I suspect ProGuard/R8 keeps different classes in debug vs release so some interceptor/authenticator may be stripped?

tanya: Yep — seen that before. If an Interceptor class isn't referenced in a way that R8 can see, it might get renamed/removed. If your auth setup relies on reflection or @Keep, release will break. Also note coroutine cancellations: suspend wrappers may not call Call.cancel() unless adapter handles it. That can look like a hang even when UI cancels.

maria: Two separate issues could overlap: (1) missing callTimeout => infinite waits in some network hang cases, (2) R8 stripping auth/interceptor => requests never get the right headers -> server returns 401 and maybe server stalls in your flow.

aj: Workarounds: set explicit callTimeout on OkHttpClient, add keep rules for your interceptor (-keep class com.redwood.sdk.auth.** { *; }), and ensure your Retrofit suspend adapter maps coroutine cancel -> call.cancel(). We patched our kotlin client in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4321 to set callTimeout and add a small shim.

kevin: Can you try reproducing with callTimeout set? Also share the stacktrace/logs if any (adb logcat).

samir: Added callTimeout = 60s locally and release build now errors after 60s with okhttp: timeout, which is better than hanging. Still going to add keep rules and test authenticator.

aj: I'll open a small DX task to align Java/Kotlin wrappers to always set sane defaults (callTimeout 60s), and add sample proguard rules in docs.

devex-bot: Created task DX-821: "Align OkHttp defaults for Android SDK + add R8 rules" assigned to @aj. :white_check_mark:

samir: Thanks! Leaving notes in the sample app README with a repro script and quick fix.

maria: Great — we should also add a tiny integration test in CI that builds a release APK and runs the minimal flow to catch regressions.

samir: Agreed. I'll draft a short CI job and link it in the PR.
